pc_changelog:
v3.0.0 — Networking Overhaul, Performance & Size Optimization

• CRITICAL: Fixed CORS missing X-Pairing-Key — root cause of all cross-device HTTP 400 errors
• Fixed: Integrity retry downloads now include authentication headers
• Fixed: Name-based sender URL fallback when device ID format doesn't match
• Startup optimization: Deferred icon loading — window appears instantly, icons load progressively
• Removed unused MaterialDesignThemes (9.5MB) and Newtonsoft.Json dependencies
• Smooth scroll physics with frame-time normalization and direction-reversal braking
android_changelog:
v3.0.0 — Cross-Device Sync Reliability & Size Optimization

• Fixed: Android uploads now include X-Pairing-Key for proper authentication
• Fixed: Fresh Cloudflare URL lookup from active_devices before downloading
• Removed 6 unused native dependencies (haptics, symbols, slider, web, worklets, status-bar)
• Reduced APK size with dependency cleanup
